issues.description: The commented example usages in the template Main class show constructors with two parameters (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), but the problem specification (UML and text) defines Animal with only a name attribute and the solution implements all animal constructors with a single String name parameter. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected constructor signatures and may lead them to implement incorrect constructors or be unsure which constructor to provide.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor usage consistent across artifacts. EITHER update the template Main comments to use single-argument constructors (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle"), Pig("Doodle"), Goat("Buttinsky")) to match the UML and solution; OR, if a second attribute (like species/type) is intended, update the problem statement UML and the solution constructors to include and initialize that second attribute. The simpler fix is to change the template Main examples to single-argument constructors to match the specification.
